s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic recurrent painful ulcerations of the lower limbs with livedo pattern
salient_findings: Recurrent painful ulcerations on both legs and feet
Reticular purplish livedo pattern over both lower limbs
Chronic nonhealing ulcers on the lateral malleolus and the dorsum of the foot
key_facts: 31-year-old woman
4-year history of recurrent painful ulcerations
No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease
No arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms
No tobacco or illicit drug use
No medications
Reticular purplish livedo pattern on examination
Multiple chronic nonhealing ulcers on the lower limbs
White atrophic scars on the lower legs and ankles
Lesional skin biopsy performed

shortlist.label: Livedoid vasculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Reticular purplish livedo pattern and chronic nonhealing ulcers on the lower limbs

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible thrombophilia

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic nonhealing ulcers and livedo pattern, possible vasculitis

shortlist.label: Thromboangiitis obliterans
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible vascular disease

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Possible immune-mediated vasculitis and livedo pattern

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of recurrent painful ulcerations, reticular purplish livedo pattern, and white atrophic scars on the lower limbs is most consistent with livedoid vasculopathy, a condition characterized by recurrent ulcerations and livedo reticularis due to thrombosis of the small and medium-sized vessels.

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
rejected.why: No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease, and no other symptoms suggestive of antiphospholipid syndrome

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Lack of systemic symptoms such as arthralgia, and the presence of a more localized pattern of ulcerations and livedo reticularis

rejected.label: Thromboangiitis obliterans
rejected.why: No history of tobacco use, which is a strong risk factor for thromboangiitis obliterans

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: No other symptoms suggestive of systemic lupus erythematosus, such as arthralgia, and no personal or family history of autoimmune disease
